title: Showing requested power and delivered power separately in a Godot grid sandbox
author: ViceGodIm
selftext:
I built this Godot scene for a small AI-controlled power-budget experiment. The model works from structured state and chooses commands. The simulator allocates the available MW and logs what each load actually receives. Godot reads the recorded state for the visuals.



The screenshot is the case that made the distinction matter. The data center was requested on, but it received only 3 of its 7 MW. I put the delivered amount next to the building and the city totals in the HUD, so the viewer can see the shortage even while the building is partly lit.



The walkthrough also shows how I replayed the recorded states after changing one generator command. [https://youtu.be/xC\_hTndnA-o](https://youtu.be/xC_hTndnA-o)
